## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
$env:NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '1'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/assessment-lifecycle.test.ts
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git status --short --branch
```

Pass means the focused suite reports 4/4, full CI reports 101/101 and exits `0`, governance reports 7/7, diff check has no errors, and only the 19 documented Prompt 13 plus Prompt 12 acceptance-reconciliation paths are changed. Passing does not mark PB2-13 ACCEPTED.

## Diff summary

The change replaces generic assessment values with canonical strict state, adds a pure structured workspace with automatic contradiction disclosure, and routes adopt/revise/withdraw through one-slot atomic decisions. A bounded opt-in step-13 adapter updates metadata without rewriting player conclusions. It adds no authoritative free text, real assessment, production threshold, hidden-state inference, or second mutable source of truth.
